canonical_statement: The quality-improvement initiative aimed to reduce time to therapeutic effectiveness of weight-based unfractionated heparin in neurocritical care patients at high risk of bleeding.
The report compared a retrospective historical cohort with a prospectively observed quality-improvement cohort in a single academic neurocritical care unit.

population.label: Adult neurocritical care patients requiring therapeutic anticoagulation and considered at high risk of intracranial hemorrhage; historical and QI cohorts

canonical_statement: The historical cohort comprised 21 consecutive patients treated from May to October 2014, and the QI cohort comprised 21 patients treated from February to July 2015.

canonical_statement: The authors recommended that cerebrovascular centers and neurocritical care units using conservative heparin nomograms periodically reassess protocol effectiveness and time to therapeutic target.
The authors stated that a large multicenter patient registry would be the best way to assess safety and effectiveness of conservative neurocritical-care heparin protocols.
